summary: International Media Acquisition Corp., a Delaware blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a $2,000 deposit into its trust account to extend its deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from October 2, 2026 to November 2, 2026. The letter to Continental Stock Transfer & Trust, dated September 22, 2026, marks the 22nd of up to 24 monthly extensions. No target, price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. Watch the remaining extension runway and liquidation risk if no deal is announced.
